notes.title: It’s time to banish the darkness
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=EtrC_8QnjOs;full][b]Trailer not yet published[/b][/previewyoutube]

[h2] The Land of the Magnates released today![/h2]
We are so excited to announce that The Land of the Magnates, the game that we were working on for more than two years, is out now. We were able to complete our journey because of your support along the way, the team really appreciate all of your support and we are grateful. So dive in to experience the tale of the Exiled Prince, enjoy!

[h3]🎶 A rhythmic action-adventure game[/h3]

Music is one of the key cores of Land of the Magnates, since without it the kingdom will suffer from demons and darkness. You will fight enemies with a magical Sitar that each string brings the power of one of the main elements: Fire, Ice and Stone.
H3: 🕮 Unravel the Middle-Eastern folktales with the power of UE5
We tried to make some of the most famous Middle-Eastern folktales alive and beautiful, and with the help of Unreal Engine 5, we were able to reach our goal and create a gorgeous world full of magical creatures and beautiful scenery.

[h3]🧩 A puzzled world[/h3]
The Land of the Magnates is full of little puzzles that bring a different challenge to the game; take a breath from the fast-paced combats and ready yourself for the puzzles that lay ahead.
💸 Let’s celebrate the launch and save some money!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2816570/The_Land_of_the_Magnates/
In order to celebrate the launch, Land of the Magnates is 10% off until the 1st of September. If you want to dive into our game, now is the perfect time to start your journey as the Exiled Prince. 

[h3]💞 How You Can Support Us[/h3]
We are a small indie team, and we appreciate any support you can give us.
[list]
[*] We'd love to hear your thoughts. If you buy the game, please consider leaving an honest review on Steam! It would help us tremendously to get the word out on Steam. 
[*] Sharing the game with friends and family can help more people discover this amazing adventure. A simple share or casual discussion can make a big difference for indie games
[*] Join our amazing community on [url=https://x.com/landofmagnates]Twitter [/url]and connect with other gamers who love The Land of the Magnates
[/list]

Save your kingdom and return the peace to your people, good luck
The Permanent Way team

notes.title: We have exciting news, The Land of the Magnates will launch on August 27th
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Nfb82t125xc;full][/previewyoutube]

The rhythmic action-adventure game, Land of the Magnates, will be available on August 27th on Steam!
[h2]🪕 Solve puzzles and fight enemies with your magical Sitar![/h2]
Solve puzzles and fight enemies with ice, fire, and stone through your Sitar, but this Sitar is not complete, as you have to recover each string to gain the power of the elements. 
[h2]🏰 Explore an ancient kingdom [/h2]
As an exiled prince, you must banish the darkness that shrouds your kingdom with the help of your magic Sitar! Explore diverse worlds, from the cursed Black Forest to the Land of the Sun, and engage in side-scrolling action-adventure gameplay, all in a beautiful world made by Unreal Engine 5.
[h2]⏱️ Speed is key [/h2]
In order to bring peace back to your kingdom, you need to be agile, because the challenges that lay ahead of you require quick thinking and agile fingers! 
[h2]💞 Join Us [/h2]
While you’re at it, don’t forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2816570/The_Land_of_the_Magnates/]give us a wishlist[/url] and join our [url=https://x.com/landofmagnates]Twitter [/url]community to join the countdown to launch day. 
Store Page Link

Can't wait to see you there
Permanent Way Studio

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo is Live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We’re excited to announce that we are participating in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest_jun2024][b]Steam Next Fest[/b][/url] from June 10th until June 17th!

As part of our participation, there is a free demo available for everyone to give the game a try during the event and we’d love to read your feedback on it through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2816570/discussions/1/]Steam Discussions[/url]!

[url=steam://install/2950140][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913339/6efd53aa6400ee386482372de986922bd78db2b8.png[/img][/url]

[i]Keep in mind the demo will be available for a limited time and will come down on July 8th.[/i]

During the event, we will have two broadcasts where you can see the game being played by our team. Both of these broadcasts are pre-recorded and will be looped throughout the duration of Next Fest. You can also catch them while they are featured at the below times:

[u][b]Next Fest Broadcast #1[/b][/u]
[i]Tuesday, June 11th at 7:00 AM PT[/i]

[u][b]Next Fest Broadcast #2[/b][/u]
[i]Thursday, June 13th at 1:00 PM PT[/i]

Don’t forget to wishlist the game so you don’t miss out on any news and thank you for all of your support so far!
